intro.descriptionHtml: The 6 Mukhi Rudraksha blesses its wearer with an energetic, dynamic and positive outlook. It brings confidence, determination, enthusiasm, success and victory. The wearer this rudraksha is hallowed with youthful appearance and desire fulfilment. The 6 mukhi rudraksha connects the wearer to Mother Earth.

tabs.tab1_description:
6 Mukhi Nepalese Rudraksha is endowed with vigor and gives quick results in the pursuit of any endeavor. It rapidly revamps our aptitude to resolve situations and face adversity by focusing our attention on success and achievement. It removes all forms of fatigue, laziness and dullness. It greatly helps in the release of chronic lethargy, the overcoming of addictions, and the bestowing of will power, courage, and self-assurance on the wearer, who is blessed with good luck and materialistic assets such as properties and vehicles. It attracts positivity and good fortune and brings stability in all aspects of one’s life by grounding the wearer. It enhances the charm of the wearer by balancing its Manipura chakra. As per Vedic astrology, the 6 mukhi rudraksha is ruled by the planet Mars. This association confers the power of action and taking initiative in all sort of activities to this rudraksha. Its wearer is content to follow his or her path and is constantly looking for ways to improve what they want and need to accomplish. Perhaps it is due to the inherent stamina of the 6 mukhi rudraksha in order to achieve the highest possible aims and goals, that its wearer always emerges victorious defeating its enemies. Both, the demons of the mind and those of the external world are conquered by 6 mukhi rudraksha. These are the six imperfections (vasanas) which trouble the human mind. Kama (lust), Krodha (anger), Lobha (greed), Moha (attachment), Ahankar (ego), and Matsarya (jealousy). These six weaknesses are removed by wearing 6 mukhi rudraksha, eventually subduing the ego to attain final Victory.

Scriptural Reference of 6 Mukhi Rudraksha

Shiva Purana. Chapter 25, Sloka 71.

Shadvaktrah kartikeyastu dharanaddakshine bhuje |
Brahmahatyadikai: papairmuchyate natra samshayah || 71 ||
Six faced Rudraksha is the form of Lord Kartikeya. This has to be worn on the right hand. There is no doubt that it rinses the sin of Brahma-hatya. 

Padma Purana, Adhyaya 57, Shloka 62:

।। वाग्मी धीरः सभायां च तृपवेश्मनी संसदि न च कातरता मेति तैव भंगो भवेद्ध्रुवम् ।।

Translation: The wearer of a 6 Mukhi Rudraksha becomes a skilled speaker, courageous in assemblies and councils, and does not become timid or nervous.

Padma Purana, Chapter 59, Shloka 61 (summary):

He who wears on his right arm a six-mouthed Rudraksha (symbol of Kartikeya) is freed from such sins as brahmanacide. One brave like Skanda does not get defeated even at the end of the world; he becomes virtuous, honored, and eloquent. Parvati, the giver of boons, is easily accessible to him as a mother.

6 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha is available in a variety of sizes, including: small, regular, large and collector. The bigger the size of the rudraksha the faster the results. This is because the seeds are bigger and the surface area in contact with skin is larger, thus, energy is dispersed more quickly throughout the body.

What differentiates Nepal and Java 6 mukhi Rudrakshas?

The internal structure of the Nepal and Java varieties of 6 mukhi rudraksha is identical, so their properties are equal. However, the long-term effects of both varieties are nearly identical. Because Nepal beads are rarer than Java beads, the 6 mukhi from Nepal is more expensive than 6 mukhi from Java. However, many people prefer Java beads because they are smaller and can be worn as alluring jewellery. It is up to the individual to decide.

Likewise, spiritual seekers immensely benefit from this rudraksha too. It is also a symbol of knowledge, the ruler of this rudraksha, Lord Kartikeya, is related with the Six Darsanas of knowledge and the Six Vedangas or Limbs of the Vedas, and also with the Six Upangas. Consequently, wearing 6 mukhi rudraksha brings great help to students in excelling academically and achieving high grades, as well as those facing extremely competitive examinations. The combination of this action oriented rudraksha with its wisdom helps to cultivate patience, and to improve endurance and tolerance. The 6 mukhi rudraksha is an effective bead for goal-oriented individuals because it makes them more active and focused on getting what they want rather than being driven by distraction.

In the case you shake a rudraksha bead and you can hear the seeds rattling, that means the rudraksha bead is lifeless.

tabs.tab4_description:
How to identify original 6 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha? 

Some fraudulent tests have gained popularity and must be avoided because their results are unreliable and they cannot be used to determine the authenticity of Rudraksha.

The Fake tests are the Water Test, Milk test or Copper Coin Rotation Test. All these tests are unscientific and produce untrustworthy results.

One way to determine the originality of Rudraksha beads is to take an X-ray. In an X-ray, the compartment and seeds inside the Rudraksha are observable, and their number should ideally correspond to the number of Mukhi lines on the bead. Sometimes all seeds are not visible as they get compressed during formation and compartments are very close to each other, though.

Experts at Rudra Centre can examine the bead and determine if they are original or not. You can send us images and videos of your Rudraksha at the email: contact@rudracentre.com for our experts to determine authenticity.

In recent years many labs have emerged which offer Rudraksha certification however these are highly unreliable because they do not have the right knowledge and many times make mistakes in identifying Rudraksha beads. Many traders are using these labs to issue fake certificates. These labs are not able to distinguish manipulated beads where extra lines are carved on the Rudraksha to make it a higher mukhi which costs more. Also, they do not reject beads with incomplete mukhi lines which actually don’t give results. These labs are not affiliated with any central body or government, so they do not have any credibility. Hence to protect consumers Rudra Centre has opened its own laboratory and have started issuing genuine certificate where all parameters 
of the Rudraksha are analyzed. We examine whether the beads are healthy, whether the mukhi lines are complete, and whether the rudraksha beads has been manipulated.

At Rudra Centre, we issue certificates for all beads procured from us. If you want an X-ray certificate for the Rudraksha bead, then an additional INR 500 is charged per Rudraksha bead.

How to Clean & Maintain 6 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha?

Rudraksha beads can last a lifetime and be passed down through generations if cared for properly.

In cold and dry climates, rudraksha beads may develop surface-level cracks, in which case any natural unscented oil may be applied, such as olive oil, sandal oil, or cow ghee.

Rudraksha may develop molds and insects if they are kept in a humid place and unused for a long time, in this case follow the below steps:

  • Dip the Rudraksha beads in lukewarm water for 15 mins.
  • Clean any molds visible of the surface using a toothbrush.
  • Dry them under the shade of the Sun (indirect Sunlight) or you can also use a dryer or hairdryer.
  • After following the above steps, you can start wearing your rudraksha beads or combination again.

Follow the steps below to regularly clean your Rudraksha beads:

  • Wash Rudraksha beads under running water.
  • Scrub the surface of the rudraksha to remove any dust particles caught in the grooves, using a toothbrush.
  • Use the shade of the Sun (indirect sunlight) or a hairdryer to dry the beads.
  • Apply any natural and unscented oil like Olive oil, Almond oil or Sandal oil.
  • If you are planning to not wear beads for a long duration, it is advisable to keep them in the fridge.
  • Do not use any chemical cleaner or insecticide or pesticide to clean or treat your Rudraksha.
  • Do not put your rudraksha beads in boiling water or extremely hot water.

6 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha Health & Color

6 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha will become darker overtime with usage because it is exposed to oil, sweat and the environment, this is a natural process and doesn’t affect the energy of the Rudraksha bead. It is best to choose a light Sandy Brown to Brown color Rudraksha bead as it generally means the bead is healthy and freshly (recently) harvested. It is advised to avoid wearing dark black or dark grey color beads as they may be lifeless. To check if the bead is healthy and alive just shake the bead well and if you hear the seeds inside rattling then it means that the bead is lifeless or dead and if there is no rattling sound then the bead is healthy and alive. You can inspect the bead from all sides and look inside the natural hole to ensure that there are no white color molds or insects which have infested the bead. Sometimes the soap gets stuck in the grooves, which are white in color; therefore, you should determine whether the white deposits are soap or mold. The mold will appear as threads whereas the soap deposits will be like a cream or paste. The energy of the Rudraksha beads resides is in its seeds, thus we must ensure that the seeds are healthy and alive.
